creator: Alexander Terp
description: The 'fast is a feature' desideratum needs a standing measurement, not a one-off. Measure at the same injected edges the test harness uses (architecture.md, seams and test hooks): input-to-glyph latency, per-event core work, per-frame render cost - at 1 and 15 panes, local and over SSH. Fails the build on regression once a baseline exists. Distinct from the stage-1 double-emulation spike, which answers 'is this viable at all'; this answers 'did we just make it worse'.
title: Perf harness: budget input-to-glyph at 1 and 15 panes
